description:
Reads one translated string by key in one language (default: the app's default language).
Use when: the game needs a single text, for example a dynamic message.
Not for: loading the UI texts at start (use horizon_get_all_localizations) or finding out which languages exist (use horizon_get_localization_languages).
Side effects: None (read only).
Returns: {localizationKey, value, language, found}. A missing key or translation is not an error: found is false and value null, so show a fallback text.
Errors: Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

key.description: Localization key exactly as defined in the dashboard, for example 'ui.play_button' (max 100 characters)

lang.description: ISO 639-1 language code (2 lowercase letters). One of: en, de, es, fr, it, pt, nl, pl, ru, ja, zh, ar, ko, tr, id. Omit for the app's default language.

name: horizon_get_localization

anyOf.description: false when the key has no translation
ISO 639-1 code of the language used
The translated text, null when not found

title: Get Localization
